# `android` operations

29 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### android.screen

**Android screen preview**

Save an Android device's screen as a PNG at path at once, through adb exec-out screencap, within 10 seconds and without a job, for previews that refresh such as the desktop's device grid. The result has the file's size and the picture's width and height. For evidence kept with a job, use device.capture.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of the PNG to write; an existing file is replaced. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.screen '{"device":"<device>","path":"<path>"}'
```

### android.store_screenshots

**Capture store screenshots**

Capture store screenshots of an installed Android app as a job: on each device, for each app language (set with android.settings app_locale, Android 13 and newer) and each of light and dark mode, every screen in order: stop and launch the app, run the screen's testing.run steps, wait settle_ms and save the screen. Files go to DIRECTORY/THEME/LOCALE/images/KIND/NN_SCREEN.png, where KIND is phoneScreenshots, sevenInchScreenshots or tenInchScreenshots by the device's smallest width, so each THEME folder is a fastlane supply metadata directory. Animations are off while capturing; each device's dark mode, animations and app language are put back afterwards. report.json lists every file with its size and play_problems (a side under 320 or over 3840 pixels, or longer than 2:1).

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_id` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Application ID of the installed app |
| `devices` | array of string | yes |  | 1 to 8 items; Serials from device.list, at most one per screen size group |
| `locales` | array of string | yes |  | 1 to 30 items; App languages as Google Play's language codes, such as en-US or de-DE |
| `themes` | array of string |  |  | items one of `light`, `dark`; 1 to 2 items; Defaults to light only |
| `screens` | array of object | yes |  | 1 to 10 items; Screens in store order |
| `screens[].name` | string | yes |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; File name part of this screen |
| `screens[].steps` | array of object |  | `[]` | up to 100 items; testing.run scenario steps that lead from the launched app to this screen |
| `directory` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of an empty or new directory for the screenshots |
| `settle_ms` | integer |  | `1000` | 0 to 30000; Wait after the last step before capturing |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `3600` | 10 to 86400; Seconds for the whole job |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.store_screenshots '{"bundle_id":"<bundle_id>","devices":["<device>"],"locales":["<locale>"],"screens":[{"name":"<name>"}],"directory":"<directory>"}'
```

**Device settings for tests**

Read or set what changes an app's look and motion in UI tests and screenshots: dark mode, font scale, animations, airplane mode and one app's language. Arguments left out stay as they are; the result reads every setting back and reports a value Android did not apply as setting_not_applied.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |

| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |

| `font_scale` | number |  |  | 0.5 to 2; System font size; 1 is the default |
| `animations` | boolean |  |  | false sets the window, transition and animator scales to 0; true sets them to 1 |
| `airplane_mode` | boolean |  |  | Android 11 and newer |

**Display orientation and size**

Lock the screen orientation, override the display size or density, or reset them, on a phone or emulator; the result reads all three back. A value Android did not apply answers setting_not_applied. With no other argument it only reads.

| `width` | integer |  |  | 100 to 10000; Override width in pixels, with height |
| `height` | integer |  |  | 100 to 10000; Override height in pixels, with width |

### android.each

**Run on every Android device**

Run the same steps on every connected Android device, or on the listed ones, as one job: all devices at once, each device's steps in order until one fails. A step that returns a job is followed to its end. The job's report.json artifact has every device's result; the job fails if any device failed. Steps leave out device and platform, which are set per device.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | array of object | yes |  | 1 to 20 items |
| `steps[].operation` | string | yes |  | one of `device.install`, `device.app`, `android.launch`, `android.permission`, `android.settings`, `android.display`, `android.deep_link`, `android.input`, `android.notifications` |
| `steps[].arguments` | object |  | `{}` | The operation's arguments without device and platform |
| `devices` | array of string |  |  | up to 100 items; Serials from device.list; all online Android devices when left out |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `1800` | 10 to 86400; Seconds for the whole job |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.each '{"steps":[{"operation":"device.install"}]}'
```

### android.pair

**Pair over Wi-Fi by QR code**

Wireless debugging pairing by QR code, for Android 11 and newer. action qr makes a one-time service name and password and returns the QR code the phone's Developer options &gt; Wireless debugging &gt; Pair device with QR code scans: qr_text, the modules as qr.rows (1 is dark), an SVG, and with path a PNG or SVG file. Nothing is stored. action wait, with that service and password, waits up to timeout seconds for the phone to offer the code on the local network (adb mdns), pairs with adb pair and connects to the phone's debugging service; the result names the device to use. Call wait again while the code shows; pairing_timeout means the phone has not scanned it yet. action services lists what adb finds on the network, such as the address the phone shows under Pair device with pairing code, for android.connect with pairing_code.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string |  | `"qr"` | one of `qr`, `wait`, `services`; qr shows a new code, wait pairs once the phone scanned it, services lists discovered devices. |
| `service` | string |  |  | For wait: the service name action qr returned. |
| `password` | string |  |  | For wait: the password action qr returned. |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `60` | 1 to 300; For wait: how many seconds to wait for the phone. |
| `path` | string |  | `""` | For qr: an absolute path ending in .png or .svg to write the code to. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.pair
```

### android.avd_configure

**Set emulator performance**

Persist graphics, RAM and CPU settings for a stopped registered Android emulator. Preserves app data and other configuration, saves the original configuration, and skips incompatible VM snapshots on subsequent Tomacco starts. Running AVDs are rejected.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `gpu` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `host`, `software`, `swiftshader`, `lavapipe` |
| `memory_mb` | integer |  |  | 512 to 32768 |
| `cores` | integer |  |  | 1 to 32 |
| `vulkan` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `on`, `off`; Vulkan compatibility override; off keeps OpenGL ES and avoids the Vulkan interoperability path. Requires a cold restart. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.avd_configure '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### android.avd_start

**Start emulator**

Start or reuse an Android virtual device. CPU acceleration remains enabled independently of the selected GPU renderer. A start with a window needs X11 (DISPLAY, XWayland on Wayland) and is refused with emulator_no_display without it; the emulator gets QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb when the session names only wayland. With gpu configured and the AVD's default auto renderer, a host without a hardware GPU driver starts with swiftshader (gpu in the result says so).

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `headless` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `software` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `gpu` | string |  | `"configured"` | one of `configured`, `auto`, `host`, `software`, `swiftshader`, `lavapipe`; configured respects the saved AVD renderer; auto selects a compatible renderer; host uses the computer GPU. An override applies to this start. Changing renderer requires stopping the emulator first. |
| `cold_boot` | boolean |  | `false` | Skip saved VM snapshots, for example after changing the GPU renderer. App data is retained. |
| `audio` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable the emulator host audio backend independently of headless mode. Embedded clients can disable this and use runtime.audio instead. Applied only to a new emulator process. |
| `vulkan` | string |  | `"configured"` | one of `configured`, `auto`, `on`, `off`; Vulkan compatibility override; off keeps OpenGL ES and avoids the Vulkan interoperability path. Requires a cold restart. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.avd_start '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### android.package_inspect

**Inspect APK or AAB**

Read an APK or AAB without a device: package, version name and code, minimum, target and compile SDK, permissions, native ABIs and signing certificates with their SHA-256 digests. APKs go through aapt2 and apksigner from the SDK build-tools; an AAB's manifest is read directly and its signature through keytool. Reads the file only.

| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of an .apk or .aab file |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.package_inspect '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### android.size_report

**Report APK or AAB size**

Break an APK or AAB down by size without a device: totals, each category (dex, native, resources, assets, manifest, signature), each ABI, screen density and bundle module, and the largest files. estimate.by_abi_density adds up the compressed sizes one device would get without other ABIs' libraries and other densities' resources. For an AAB with bundletool configured, download has bundletool get-size total's download size per ABI and density, from APKs it builds in a temporary directory. baseline compares with an earlier build: the change of every total and the files that grew, shrank, appeared or went away the most.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute path of an .apk or .aab file |
| `baseline` | string |  | `""` | Absolute path of an earlier .apk or .aab to compare with |
| `top` | integer |  | `15` | 1 to 200; How many of the largest and most changed files to list |
| `bundletool` | boolean |  | `true` | For an AAB, also ask bundletool for the download size; false reads the file only |

```sh
tomaccoctl call android.size_report '{"path":"<path>"}'
```
